agency: Department of Housing and Urban Development
summary: HUD responded that many Lustron homes are still occupied as acceptable housing and that the corporation's failure was due to financial problems rather than design, and declined to include this history in the statement.
text: Response: This comment cites the "Lustron" home as possibly being rejected due to sociological or environmental problems. Many Lustron homes are still being occupied as acceptable housing; the failure of the corporation was due to financial problems more than to design. It does not seem appropriate to discuss this type of history in the statement.

closing_anchor: It does not seem appropriate to discuss this type of history in the statement.
